about: Keys for labels the backend sends, which the panel shows as they are or in capitals. They match no panel source string, so the stale key check would drop them. Each must still match a backend value (tests/unit/test_panel_i18n.py). Review these in the release that finishes the panel.
labels: Deep-focus/work — hold non-critical interrupts, terse tone.
Default operation — balanced proactivity and voice.
Focused workshop/lab work — minimal interruptions, dry tone, safety still fully active.
Guests over — relax nagging, keep it light, only surface genuinely notable things.
Houseguest staying — softer autonomy, plainer voice, avoid acting on unfamiliar patterns.
Household away — proactive convenience off, security posture emphasized, only notable/critical events.
Morning and evening summaries of weather, calendar, overnight events, and energy, in Settings under Briefings. Anticipation and cross-session memory live under Anticipation and Memory.
Movie/theater mode — near-silent, only critical alerts, no convenience chatter.
Nest/Frigate cameras enable doorbell analysis, package detection, the live floor plan.
On HA OS/Supervised Nova installs the voice stack for you. Done when an Assist pipeline uses Nova as its conversation agent (Settings → Voice assistants).
Plain, dry, or full — how much of Nova's quiet wit comes through. Settings → Character.
Where Nova sends security alerts and notifications (your phone).
